objects.name: Analytic 2213
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an abrupt cessation of expected Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol traffic between a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/control server and a field device, without a corresponding device alarm or scheduled maintenance event, while the device remains reachable for at least some traffic types. This technique-level analytic synthesizes Command Message blocking (T1691.001) and Reporting Message blocking (T1691.002). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
